title: Duration
description: How long an effect, condition or spell lasts, and what ends it early.

kind.description: 'until_event' ends at the event in 'until' (e.g. start of your next turn); 'while' lasts as long as 'while' holds; 'special' is described in the source text and needs a master decision or a rule elsewhere.

up_to.description: True when the source says 'up to' (the effect may end sooner, e.g. concentration).

ends_on.description: Additional events that end the duration early (e.g. the target takes damage).

text.description: The source's duration wording, verbatim (e.g. 'Concentration, up to 1 minute').

event_ref.description: A registered event, optionally scoped to whose turn/rest it is.

which.description: 'next' = the next occurrence after the effect starts; 'each' = every occurrence.
